integrity: The theorem is justified by a complete algebraic proof and two reproducible exhaustive finite checks. The computation is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Prior two-factor classifications are expressly acknowledged.
limitations: Finite fields on the two diagonal blocks; finite nonzero unital bimodule; independent uniform factors. No minimum-order claim for the 256-element pair, no extension to all finite rings, and no certified historical priority.
title: Universal multi-factor product fibers in triangular field-bimodule rings
